\begin{bankq}[id=SI11-P1-CHEM-S2-Q07, source={Score-I - Test 11 (27 Feb 2022)}, paper=1, qno=7, type=multi, subtopic={Laws}, answer={A,B,C}, answer_src=key, difficulty=6, diff_parts={K1 S2 I2 C1 F1}, diff_note={concepts: which process the van der Waals work expression applies to | steps: external pressure term equals van der Waals pressure RT/(V - b) - a/V^2; therefore applies to a van der Waals gas; reversible isothermal expansion since external pressure equals gas pressure; check options | I: identify P_ext as the gas equation of state at reversible conditions}, also_in={JEE Advanced (2021 Series) - Test 02 (04 Feb 2021) P1 Q7}]
In thermodynamics the P-V work done is given by $w=-\int dV\,P_{\text{ext}}$.\\
For a system undergoing a particular process, the work done is, $w=-\int dV\left(\dfrac{RT}{V-b}-\dfrac a{V^2}\right)$\\
This equation is applicable to a
\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{System that satisfies the van der Waals equation of state.}
\opt{B}{Process that is reversible and isothermal.}
\opt{C}{Process that is reversible and adiabatic.}
\opt{D}{Process that is irreversible and at constant pressure.}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}

Tin is obtained from cassiterite by reduction with coke. Use the data given below to determine the minimum temperature (in K) at which the reduction of cassiterite by coke would take place.\\
At 298 K : $\Delta_fH^\circ(\mathrm{SnO_2(s)})=-581.0$ kJ mol$^{-1}$, $\Delta_fH^\circ(\mathrm{CO_2(g)})=-394.0$ kJ mol$^{-1}$\\
$S^\circ(\mathrm{SnO_2(s)})=56.0$ J K$^{-1}$ mol$^{-1}$, $S^\circ(\mathrm{Sn(s)})=52.0$ J K$^{-1}$ mol$^{-1}$,\\
$S^\circ(\mathrm{C\ (s)})=6.0$ J K$^{-1}$ mol$^{-1}$, $S^\circ(\mathrm{CO_2(g)})=210.0$ J K$^{-1}$ mol$^{-1}$.\\
